answers.In a sentence or two, what will it do fo: It screens job applications and shortlists candidates for interview, for roles across our European entities.
answers.What kind of AI is it?: Gives a score, ranking, flag, category or forecast — e.g. a credit score, a fraud alert, a ranking of CVs, the likely cause of a problem
What information will it see or use?: Information about people — clients, applicants, staff or anyone else: names, contact details, account and financial details, CVs — anything about someone who can be identified
answers.What happens with what it produces?: suggests, ranks or flags things, and a person decides what to do
answers.Who ends up seeing or receiving what it: Only me or my own team
answers.Which of these does it help decide, if a: Who to hire or promote — including tools that only produce notes, transcripts or summaries a person later uses to decide
answers.How widely will it be used?: Several teams, the whole business, or every case of a kind (e.g. all applications)

ticksMean: 'I've checked this answer' means I have read the answer the model filled in and agree with it, not that I just accepted it.
